decisions.reason: Report grounds the diagnosis in renderer-excerpt.ts half-filled branches (fg-only ▀/▄), explains stale SGR background leaking into the EMPTY half of the cell at right edges (outline/sleep-Z/heart), and gives the precise fix: explicit default background ESC[49m in both half-filled branches. Does not blame the terminal.

Cites the out.replace(/[ ]+$/,'') trim dropping trailing cells so shorter rows never overwrite surplus columns, and gives a two-part fix: full-width rows with explicit ESC[K (or keep-width padding) plus erasing previous frame's extents (union bounding box) on switch. Both parts present.

Reads frames-digest-report.txt: tail2 is the hand-ported drifted frame (23 cells, 1-col left shift) and the excerpt-based regression missed it because it covers excerpts of a different frame. Gate: digest every frame (lists all) as full sha256 against source art in CI; drift attributed to frame data, not rendering.

Grounds in ci-hang-evidence.txt: self-re-arming setTimeout keeps event loop alive; CI hosts mount the sprite component and finish without unmounting so dispose never runs; interactive terminal unaffected (TTY/stdin keeps it alive). One-line fix timer.unref(); does not blame runner slowness or require unmount rework (unmount only as optional follow-up).

Checklist contains the concrete items: explicit background reset per half-filled cell (ESC[49m), full-width rows / erase-to-EOL, per-frame digests pinned to source art, plus a pre-flip audit covering timer hygiene (unref/clear) and mount/unmount behavior of every embedding host.
